cohort: Nine women with a final diagnosis of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) presenting to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, MLN Medical College and Saket Maternity Nursing Home, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, between January 2017 and February 2021.
finding: The majority of CSP cases (67%) had one previous cesarean section, with a median duration of 2 years since the last cesarean section, and 55% of these cesarean sections were performed without labor; 67% of patients reported abortifacient intake during the current pregnancy.
